## 席位核对 — REWORK · head 4e94d7d45cb73e1590dcbddf2921179dde386eee

L1 review of #37162 against #37031, read at 2026-11-25T01:18Z from the PR's committed tree (base `1f3e9f68e70`, one commit).

### Must-fix

1. **`ResourceEditPage.tsx`: the new `shippedLayerOf` helper is wedged between `holdsNoLayer`'s JSDoc and `holdsNoLayer` itself.** At head the file reads, lines 422-442: the `/** Whether a layered answer this page already read holds no layer at all ... only logs the same 404. */` block, then the new `/** The item as its package ships it ... */` block, then `function shippedLayerOf`, then a bare `function holdsNoLayer`. So `holdsNoLayer` loses its documentation (the objectui#11799 reason it exists) and `shippedLayerOf` now carries two stacked docblocks, the first describing a different function. Move `shippedLayerOf` (with its own docblock) above `holdsNoLayer`'s docblock or below `holdsNoLayer`, so each function sits directly under its own comment. Mechanical; no test change.

### Checklist

- **Shape:** draft, base `main`, first content line `Fixes #37031` (line 1 is the seat signature). `l1-face.mjs --pr 37162`: shape, first-line, relation, keywords-other-cards, releases-path, changeset, empty-changeset, nul-suspects, declarations, skills-docs all `ok`. `Fixes` is right: the card's expected result (re-tick restores `signed_on` and it persists) is what this diff delivers.
- **Premise corrected by the dev, acknowledged here:** the card's mechanism is wrong. It said the overlay merges key by key and the re-check publish answered 200. The dev measured that a save stores the whole document and that `main`'s re-tick body (`{region}` with no `dateRange`) binds the card to `issued_on`, which the account dataset lacks, so the publish answers 422 `dashboard-filter-field-unknown` and the opt-out stays. That reading (REST replay control) and the after-fix readings (PUT `{dateRange:'signed_on',region:'sales_region'}` 200, publish 200, GET `signed_on`, still `signed_on` after reload) are in the PR body's Why and Verification. The fix is on the producer side and leaves the server's merge contract alone, which fits Prime Directive #12.
- **Diff vs card:** `DashboardWidgetInspector` re-tick writes `shippedFilterBinding(shipped, widget.id, def.name)`: a string binding from the shipped widget with the same id, otherwise `undefined` (the entry is dropped, as on `main`). Untick still writes `false`. `openDashboardForEdit` takes `shipped` from the same layered read it opens `doc` from, including the base fallback, so no extra request. The read is pinned for package, base fallback, pair-holds-customization and nothing-shipped.
- **Scope, the Studio extension:** in scope. `ResourceEditPage` mounts the same `DashboardWidgetInspector` through `MetadataInspectorProps`. Without the one-line `shipped=` prop, Studio's dashboard editor would keep exactly the defect this PR fixes in the in-page editor. It meets all four conditions: same defect class, mechanical, no other claim, same gate family (app-shell vitest). The PR body names it and it is pinned in the page's existing inspector harness (`code` handed over / `null` control). The file surface stays within the claim (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/**`, `.changeset/**`).
- **Changeset:** `@object-ui/app-shell` patch, `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`. I read it sentence by sentence against the diff. Each sentence holds: the opt-out writes `{NAME: false}`; re-tick on `main` dropped the entry and bound the filter's own field; the whole-document save led to 422 `dashboard-filter-field-unknown`; the fix restores the code layer's string binding, else drops; the edit state reads `shipped` from its existing layered read; Studio passes it from the read it already keeps; no new strings. The Metadata-protocol `none` holds: a React prop on an internal module, not metadata.
- **Contract review:** not owed. The diff touches no `packages/spec/**`, declares no `Clause-②: yes`, no `(narrowing)`, and no governed path.
- **Tests:** the dev's evidence is real commands with their output (4 files / 67 passed at `4e94d7d45cb`). The ablation reverting the re-tick to `undefined` gave 1 red ("re-ticking an opt-out restores the field the shipped dashboard binds") and 21 green, as predicted, so the pin can fail. The controls (shipped `false`, no shipped binding, different widget id) pin the fallback.
- **eslint claim, verified:** `ResourceEditPage.tsx` carries 3 inline `eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/static-components` lines (3726, 3859, 3883) at base `1f3e9f68e70`, at `origin/main` and at head alike. The 3 errors under `--no-inline-config` are those same pre-existing suppressions. The diff adds none.
- **CI at 4e94d7d45cb:** all green, read from check-runs: 38 success, 13 expected skip, 0 unexpected skip, 0 failed, 0 pending. `l1-face` floor: `Lint & Repo Gates` success, `TypeScript Type Check` success; `mergeable_state` clean.
- **Non-blocking:** `shippedLayerOf` re-implements `recordOf` from `DashboardInPageEditor.tsx`. Sharing one helper is optional.
- **Out of scope:** recorded in the PR's Acceptance notes, not filed: Reset clears to the filter's own field; a re-target that exists only in the overlay comes back as the shipped binding after untick and re-tick. Both are product questions, not defects of this card.

Next: the same dev, a patch round for must-fix 1, then a fresh L1 on the new head.

## 席位核对 — ACCEPT · head 0b0d4b4bf079faae9ed571edb6125a5d7795f149

Delta L1 against REWORK 7149430001 (head `4e94d7d45cb`), read at 2026-11-25T02:40Z from the committed tree.

### Delta

- **Must-fix 1, resolved.** In `0b0d4b4bf07`, `shippedLayerOf` and its own docblock now sit above `holdsNoLayer`'s docblock (head lines 422-444). Each function is now directly under its own comment. The commit only moves lines (9+/9-), with no change in behaviour.
- **The merge did not disturb the fix.** `d3bc18e0378` merges `origin/main` at `95734fef75e` cleanly. I took the PR's delta against the merged main (`95734fef75e..0b0d4b4bf07`) and compared its added and removed lines with the original delta (`1f3e9f68e70..4e94d7d45cb`). They are identical, line for line. Same 10 files, 233+/15-. On main, the merge brought only a 4+/2- change to `ResourceEditPage.tsx`, outside the inspector mount and the layered read. The `shipped={shippedLayerOf(layered)}` prop is intact. The 3 pre-existing inline `react-hooks/static-components` disables are still in place.
- **Non-blocking, not taken.** The dev kept `recordOf` private to its own module rather than share it. Accepted.

### Checklist (carried from 7149430001; re-read where the head moved)

- `l1-face.mjs --pr 37162` at `0b0d4b4bf0`: CLEAN, 13 items read, none flagged. The PR is a draft against `main`, with `Fixes #37031` as the first content line and no closing keyword on any other card. The changeset is present and not empty. The declarations read `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none`. Skills-docs and dogfood are not owed.
- **CI at `0b0d4b4bf07`:** 38 success, 13 expected skip, 0 unexpected skip, 0 failed, 0 pending. The floor checks `Lint & Repo Gates` and `TypeScript Type Check` both passed. `mergeable_state` is clean. This also covers `check:type-check-debt` and the ui `scripts/` vitest, which the dev could not measure locally.
- **Unchanged from the first round:**
  - The fix matches the card's expected result.
  - The dev's correction of the card's premise is acknowledged: a save stores the whole document, and the publish was refused with 422 `dashboard-filter-field-unknown`.
  - The Studio `ResourceEditPage` extension is in scope: same panel, same defect class, mechanical, pinned.
  - The changeset holds when read sentence by sentence.
  - The ablation turned 1 test red, as predicted.
- **Contract review is not owed.** The PR touches no `packages/spec/**`, declares no `Clause-②: yes` and no `(narrowing)`, and changes no governed path.

### Accepted deviation

- The PR body's local readings (tests, ablation, type-check, gates, browser check) still cite `4e94d7d45cb`. They carry over to this head because the head's delta against main is line-identical to the delta they measured, apart from the docblock move. CI at this head is the gate evidence. Before landing, the body should gain one line recording that carry-over.
